# FutureVision 展示素材

产品原图 image131.png–image140.png：直接提取自用户提供的 PPTX 第 40–43 页，未改变设计。
original-project.pptx：原始完整 48 页文件。archive.json：逐页原文与图片索引。
wearing.png：使用内置 image_gen 生成的人物佩戴情境示意。产品设计以原图为准。未采用此前误解需求所生成的白色产品方案。

## 人物佩戴图生成提示词

Create ONLY a wearing-context photograph using the supplied ORIGINAL product, NOT a new product design. Image1 image139 is the exact side elevation product design; image2 image134 is exact front; image3 image140 is exact exploded construction; image4 is portrait/model styling reference only. Replace reference portrait's white Soma forehead band completely with the user's EXISTING XPeng FutureVision device. Preserve exact supplied device geometry, proportions, black/dark charcoal color, navy blue circular rim, silver sidewall, light blue XPeng X emblem, tiny coral indicator, wide smoky transparent curved visor across EYES with thin pale blue edge and nose bridge, flat wide rear band wrapping horizontally behind head. Circular earpiece sits OVER EAR, NOT temple/forehead; rear band behind occiput, NO over-top head strap. Do not miniaturize earpieces. Must look like the exact existing product render in image139, fitted naturally to the head. Adult Black male with short afro hair, dark brown skin, reference-like calm right-facing SIDE PROFILE, close-up head and shoulders, neutral gray shirt, light gray studio background, sophisticated editorial photographic lighting, subtle depth of field. Ear side emblem clearly visible, visor crossing eyes forwards toward nose. Landscape 3:2 framing, person occupies right two-thirds, open space left. No text or layout or logos beyond exact existing device emblem. No new white device, no redesign, no extra head straps, no extra components.

## 2026-09 展示升级
- 原稿下载/折叠归档入口替换为直接呈现的研究章节，以及结构、人因、CMF 展板内容。
- 三张原始 UI 单列放大，新增 pointer 浮动；触屏与 reduced motion 禁用浮动。
- gallery-bg.png：内置 image_gen 生成空白灰色建筑灯箱场景。提示：photorealistic premium gray architectural gallery, straight-on blank portrait lightbox, no text or product. 网站使用原始 image139.webp 叠加产品及文字；poster-presentation.png 为页面导出。
- futurevision-mark.svg：按用户提供的“小鹏标志 + 外环 + 两侧竖向耳机”描述绘制；logo-presentation.png 为页面导出。
- assets/zoe-cutout.png：内置 image_gen 提取用户海边生活照人物。提示：extract the woman on transparent background; preserve identity, sunglasses, LA cap, red-brown hair, yellow shirt, gray trousers and peace-sign pose; remove background only; no new person or styling. 另外两张生活照以原文件直接使用。
